rules.question: Is this Preview note inside a solo?
rules.owner: the timestamp's flag_solo in src/core/song.h, grouped by Song::solo_sections
rules.decision: D114 item 22 (M56); D114 item 22, concept audit M56.
rules.note: A Preview note carries no solo flag, because the Preview's solo spans come from Song::solo_sections. A copy of the flag on a Preview note comes back only through this spelling.
